title: Exact coherent stage families and normalized rational pullback
statement: For the stage systems of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category], an exact coherent family consists of a StageSystem.Morphism together with additive and integer-shift structures on its stage functors, shift compatibility of its beta comparisons, and preservation of distinguished triangles. For a scheme morphism whose actual completed pullback preserves the integral bounded constructible complete subcategories, define its rational pullback by restricting that actual operation and applying raw scalar localization as in [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport]. Its canonical scalar-comparison predicate says that the inverse beta, conjugated by the integral/scalar comparisons at its two endpoints, equals the unique rationalized actual completed-pullback scalar comparison of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension] on every integral object, also at equal fields. These are existing definitions extracted verbatim from the descent proposition; the direct-image analogues remain attached to [def-per-rational-direct-image-family].

structure CoherentExactMorphism {I : Type w} [Preorder I]
    {C : I → Type u} [∀ i, Category.{v} (C i)]
    {D : I → Type u'} [∀ i, Category.{v'} (D i)]
    (S : StageSystem C) (S' : StageSystem D)
    [∀ i, Preadditive (C i)] [∀ i, Preadditive (D i)]
    [∀ i, HasZeroObject (C i)] [∀ i, HasZeroObject (D i)]
    [∀ i, HasShift (C i) ℤ] [∀ i, HasShift (D i) ℤ]
    [∀ i, ∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor (C i) n).Additive]
    [∀ i, ∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor (D i) n).Additive]
    [∀ i, Pretriangulated (C i)] [∀ i, Pretriangulated (D i)]
    [∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), (S.T h).CommShift ℤ]
    [∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), (S'.T h).CommShift ℤ]
